items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Lewis Nelson wasn't on the top of him. He was a good man. Just like Jim. ... He said, hello Mr. Jim. I said hello. ... [INTERVIEWER] You taught him drum on and taught him how to talk too?

ctx.x: Well what is he a real teen? Yeah. You see that's the thing I didn't know. I'm telling you right now back in those days I didn't know. All I'd know I used to just go to the dancers they could sit down there and play it. I wouldn't know if he was playing my head or not.

I know that he wasn't a man on my top or Harrison Bond. Lewis Nelson wasn't on the top of him. He was a good man. Just like Jim. Now what did he call me? Jim. He said, hello Mr. Jim. I said hello. But my name is not Jim. He called me Jim but my name is not Jim. I said Jim I said okay I said how you feel? Okay. Because he just said I and Jim is a brother. Of course we kind of feel with him. And when we talk we almost talk like sometimes. But he's no kid at all.
You taught him drum on and taught him how to talk too?
